# History Record 222: Master Integration Plan (Iteration 6) Phase 2: Deep Collapsible Inspector Panels & 3D Numeric Suite

**Date**: 2026-10-16  
**Status**: Completed  
**Scope**: `apps/studio`, `autogenerated-tests/`  

---

## 1. Context & Objectives
In Phase 2 of Iteration 6, all 3D lighting, camera, particle simulation, and audio synthesis capabilities established in Iterations 5 and 6 are bridged into dedicated, professional collapsible inspector panels in `apps/studio/src/components/Sidebar.tsx`.
Key objectives:
1. Replace flat/minimal controls with **Deep Collapsible Accordion Panels** grouped into 6 categories: 3D Relighting, 3D Camera & Lens, Particle VFX & Shaders, Color Grading, Typography & Styling, and Audio Ducking & Pan.
2. Build dual controls for all parameters: interactive visual sliders paired with adjacent editable numeric `<Input>` fields with double-click reset to defaults.
3. Aesthetic color swatch pills (Cold Cyber Blue, Warm Tungsten, Sunset Amber, Toxic Acid, Neon Pink) plus native HTML5 color picker.
4. Section header controls: active bypass `<Switch>` toggle, reset to defaults button (↺), and remove button (🗑).
5. Smart "Add Effect" dropdown preventing duplicate modifier stacking while permitting instant attachment.
6. Undoable modifier removal via `RemoveModifierCommand` integrated into `IRStateManager`.

---

## 2. Key Technical Implementations

### 2.1 Deep Collapsible Inspector Panels (`apps/studio/src/components/Sidebar.tsx`)
- **3D Depth Relighting (`vfx/depth_relighting`)**:
  - Light color with 5 curated cinematography swatches + custom hex color picker.
  - Light position sliders $(X: -5.0 \dots 5.0, Y: -5.0 \dots 5.0, Z: 0.1 \dots 10.0\text{m})$.
  - Blinn-Phong shading knobs: Diffuse ($0.0 \dots 2.0$), Specular ($0.0 \dots 3.0$), Shininess ($4 \dots 128$), Rim Light intensity ($0.0 \dots 2.0$).
- **3D Camera & Rack Focus (`camera/3d`)**:
  - FOV ($15^\circ \dots 120^\circ$) and Camera Roll angle ($-180^\circ \dots 180^\circ$).
  - Camera Eye $(X, Y, Z)$ and Target $(X, Y, Z)$ positions.
  - Rack Focus & Bokeh: Focal Distance ($0.1 \dots 10.0\text{m}$), Focal Range Depth ($0.1 \dots 5.0\text{m}$), Bokeh Blur Radius ($0 \dots 20\text{px}$).
- **Particle VFX & Post-Processing Shaders (`overlay/canvas_particles`)**:
  - One-click presets: `cyber_sparks`, `cosmic_dust`, `matrix_rain`, `magic_embers`.
  - SIMD Particle Physics: Particle Count ($100 \dots 20,000$), Gravity ($-9.8 \dots 9.8\text{m/s}^2$), Air Drag ($0.0 \dots 1.0$), Simplex Turbulence ($0.0 \dots 5.0$).
  - Shaders: Bloom Threshold ($0.1 \dots 1.0$), Chromatic Aberration ($0 \dots 10\text{px}$).
- **Color Grading (`vfx/color_grading`)**:
  - Contrast, Saturation, Exposure, and Vignette intensity.
- **Typography & Styling (`text/style`)**:
  - Font Family dropdown (Inter, Fira Code, Outfit, Cinzel, Montserrat).
  - Font Size ($12 \dots 120\text{px}$), Font Weight ($300 \dots 900$), Letter Spacing ($-2 \dots 10\text{px}$).
  - Text Fill color, Karaoke Active Word Glow color.
- **Audio Dynamic Ducking & Pan (`sfx/dynamic_ducking`)**:
  - Duck Volume ($0 \dots 100\%$), Attack ($10 \dots 500\text{ms}$), Release ($50 \dots 2000\text{ms}$), Stereo Pan ($-1.0 \dots +1.0$).

### 2.2 Command Pattern Undoable Removal (`apps/studio/src/lib/commands/RemoveModifierCommand.ts`)
- Implemented `RemoveModifierCommand` implementing `ICommand`:
  - `execute(doc)`: captures removed modifier and original index before removing from `seq.modifiers`.
  - `undo(doc)`: restores the modifier back to its exact index in `seq.modifiers`.
- Wired into `IRStateManager.getInstance().removeModifier(sequenceId, modifierType)`.
